concerns.location: tasks.md:T003, T006 vs contracts/output.schema.yaml vs data-model.md:MMN Metric
concerns.text: FR-015 coverage is broken: T003 writes per-subject rows to metrics.csv, but output.schema.yaml has additionalProperties:false and no subject_id field, and requires cohort-level fields (t_statistic, p_value_fdr, cohen_d, significant, benchmark_reference, validation_type) on every row — impossible for Phase-1 per-subject rows before T005. No task reconciles the data model's per-subject MMN Metric with the schema's cohort-level row, so T006's contract tests cannot pass on T003's output.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs plan.md:Task 5.2 and Project Structure
concerns.text: Plan element Task 5.2 (validate stats.json against contracts/stats.schema.yaml, listed in the plan's structure tree) has no covering task: T006 validates stats.json against output.schema.yaml instead, and no stats.schema.yaml task or file exists. Either a task must create/validate against stats.schema.yaml, or the plan must be amended — currently the plan element is uncovered and the target schema is ambiguous.

All tasks write outputs to data/results/ (metrics.csv, stats.json, figures/) while the plan's canonical structure places them at results/. No task covers reconciling this divergence; T006's contract tests and T009's paper handoff reference data/results paths that contradict the plan layout the downstream stages will expect.

T003 covers FR-011 only ambiguously: it says 'noise floor (SD/SEM of the ... baseline)' while FR-011/SC-001 define the noise floor as the standard deviation. The task should state one definition so the SNR >= 3.0 criterion is measurably covered.

US-1 acceptance scenario 2 specifies an ICA artifact-component criterion ('explaining >99% variance'); T002's coverage of it says only 'reject EOG/ECG-correlated components' with no threshold, leaving that acceptance scenario unverifiable by any task.
